record.question: In relation to congenital taclipes equinovarus (CTEV), which of the following statements are false?
options: It is more common in boys.
Spina bifida is associated with CTEV.
Deformity is characterised by hindfoot equinus or varus and forefoot abduction or supination.
Pirani scoring system is used to assess the severity of CTEV and guide prognosis.
record.explanation: In CTEV the forefoot is adducted and supinated, not abducted, so option C is the false statement. Boys are more affected and spina bifida is linked to neurogenic CTEV. Source: GDMO Gr-III Technical Paper-II (2022), Q46, page 4.
